# FQHESphereWithSpinSMinus

Module: **FQHE** · directory: `FQHE/src/FQHEOnSphere` · binary: `FQHE/src/Programs/FQHEOnSphere/FQHESphereWithSpinSMinus`

```text
FQHESphereWithSpinSMinus, version 0.01

Usage: FQHESphereWithSpinSMinus [options] 

Options:

system options:
    -i, --input-file : name of the file corresponding to the input state
    --fully-unpolarized : apply the S- minus as many times as need to reach the Sz=0 (or Sz=1/2) sector
    --partially-polarized : apply the S- minus as many times as need to reach a given Sz sector
    --sz-sector : (twice the) Sz sector that should be targeted with the --partially-polarized option (default value = 0)
    --all-sz : use Hilbert-space comprising all sz sectors

output options:
    -o, --output-file : use this file name instead of the one that can be deduced from the input file name (changing the Sz value)

parallelization options:
    -S, --SMP : enable SMP mode
    --processors : number of processors to use in SMP mode (default value = 2)
    --smp-profil : enable SMP profiling, the name of the log file  has to be passed as argument

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
